# VATS Hit Chance & Accuracy Mechanics Explained

VATS calculates hit probabilities starting at 95% maximum and applies situational penalties.

---

### 🎯 Core Accuracy Factors
* **Distance & Range**: Firing within 50% of listed weapon range suffers zero penalty. Beyond maximum range, hit chance drops to 0% and damage is reduced by 50%.
* **Line of Sight**: Obstructed limbs behind cover or body mass cannot be targeted.
* **Cone of Fire & Recoil**: Automatic fire increases spread cone and lowers consecutive VATS accuracy.
* **Perception Impact**: Each point of Perception passively increases base hit probability across all ranges.
